NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

ARTICLE 1: DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) “Affiliate” means, with respect to any person, any other person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with such person.
(b) “Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in Lagos State, Nigeria.
(c) “Delivery Schedule” means the weekly delivery schedule agreed upon by the Parties as set out in Schedule A hereto, as may be amended from time to time in writing.
(d) “Force Majeure Event” means any event or circumstance beyond the reasonable control of the affected Party, including but not limited to acts of God, fire, flood, storm, earthquake, epidemic, pandemic, riot, civil commotion, strike, lockout, labour dispute, war, terrorism, governmental action, or any other similar event.
(e) “Products” means the food products and supplies listed in Schedule B hereto, as may be updated from time to time.
(f) “Quality Standards” means the standards set out in Article 4 and Schedule C hereto.
(g) “Services” means the delivery, unloading, and related services to be provided by Coastal Bites as described herein.

1.2 Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

1.3 Words importing the singular shall include the plural and vice versa, and words importing any gender shall include all genders.

ARTICLE 2: TERM AND EFFECTIVE DATE

2.1 This Agreement shall commence on 15 January 2025 (the “Effective Date”) and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of twenty-four (24) months (the “Initial Term”), unless earlier terminated in accordance with the provisions of Article 12.

2.2 Upon expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods (each a “Renewal Term”) unless either Party provides the other with written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

2.3 The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Effective Date is 15 January 2025, and all obligations, deliveries, and payments shall be calculated and performed with reference to this date. Any deliveries required prior to the Effective Date shall be governed by the terms of any prior purchase orders, and this Agreement shall only govern deliveries made on or after the Effective Date.

ARTICLE 3: SUPPLY OF PRODUCTS

3.1 Coastal Bites shall supply to LHRG, and LHRG shall purchase from Coastal Bites, the Products in such quantities as LHRG may from time to time require, subject to the minimum and maximum order quantities set out in Schedule B.

3.2 All orders for Products shall be placed by LHRG through its designated procurement officer or such other authorized representative as LHRG may notify to Coastal Bites in writing. Orders may be placed by email, telephone, or through the online ordering portal established by Coastal Bites, if any.

3.3 Each order shall specify:
(a) the Products required;
(b) the quantity of each Product;
(c) the requested delivery date and time;
(d) the delivery location; and
(e) any special handling or packaging requirements.

3.4 Coastal Bites shall acknowledge receipt of each order within four (4) hours during normal working hours (8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., WAT, Monday through Friday) and shall confirm its ability to fulfil the order within twenty-four (24) hours of receipt.
5.2 Time is of the essence for deliveries of fresh produce, seafood, and other perishable items. In the event that Coastal Bites anticipates a delay, it shall notify LHRG’s designated procurement officer immediately, and shall use its best efforts to arrange an alternative delivery that meets LHRG’s operational requirements.

5.3 Risk in the Products shall pass to LHRG upon delivery and physical acceptance of the Products at the delivery location. Title shall pass upon full payment for the relevant invoice.

5.4 LHRG shall have the right to inspect the Products at the point of delivery and to reject any Products that do not conform to the specifications set out in Schedule C, including but not limited to issues of quality, quantity, temperature, packaging, or freshness. Rejected Products shall be removed by Coastal Bites at its own cost within twenty-four (24) hours of rejection, and Coastal Bites shall issue a credit note or replacement delivery, at LHRG’s election.

5.5 Acceptance of any delivery shall not prejudice LHRG’s right to reject Products that are later discovered to be non-conforming, provided that LHRG notifies Coastal Bites within forty-eight (48) hours of discovery.

ARTICLE 6: QUALITY AND SAFETY

6.1 Coastal Bites warrants that all Products shall: (a) conform to the specifications in Schedule C; (b) be of satisfactory quality and fit for the purpose for which they are intended; (c) comply with all applicable Nigerian laws and regulations, including the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) requirements and the Lagos State Consumer Protection Agency guidelines; and (d) be sourced, handled, and transported in accordance with good hygiene practices and cold-chain standards where applicable.

6.2 Coastal Bites shall, upon request, provide LHRG with certificates of analysis, batch records, and other documentation evidencing compliance with clause 6.1. Such documentation shall be provided within five (5) business days of the request.

6.3 In the event of any suspected food safety incident involving any Products supplied under this Agreement, Coastal Bites shall: (a) notify LHRG’s operations director immediately; (b) cooperate fully with any investigation; and (c) participate in any recall or withdrawal as required by law or as reasonably directed by LHRG.

ARTICLE 7: FORCE MAJEURE

7.1 Neither Party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performing its obligations under this Agreement to the extent that such failure or delay is caused by a Force Majeure Event. For the purposes of this Agreement, a “Force Majeure Event” means any event beyond the reasonable control of the affected Party, including but not limited to: acts of God, flood, fire, explosion, epidemic or pandemic, strike or other labour dispute, riot, civil commotion, war, terrorist act, embargo, government action, or failure of public infrastructure including power supply and telecommunications, in each case provided that the affected Party has taken reasonable steps to mitigate the effects of such event.

7.2 The affected Party shall notify the other Party in writing of the Force Majeure Event within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of it, stating the nature of the event, its expected duration, and the obligations affected.

7.3 If a Force Majeure Event continues for more than thirty (30) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice with immediate effect, without liability other than for obligations accrued prior to the date of termination.

ARTICLE 8: RETURNS AND CREDITS

8.1 LHRG may return Products to Coastal Bites, and Coastal Bites shall accept such returns, where: (a) the Products are non-conforming as described in clause 5.4; (b) the Products are delivered after the agreed delivery time and LHRG has rejected them; or (c) Coastal Bites has agreed in writing to accept the return for any other reason.
ARTICLE 8 (continued)

8.2 Returns under clause 8.1(a) shall be credited in full, including the cost of the original delivery charge. Returns under clause 8.1(b) shall be credited in full, and Coastal Bites shall also bear the cost of collecting the rejected Products. Returns under clause 8.1(c) shall be credited only to the extent agreed in the written acceptance of the return.

8.3 Any credit note issued under this Article 8 shall be issued within fourteen (14) days of Coastal Bites’ receipt of the returned Products and shall be applied against LHRG’s next payment due under this Agreement. If no payment is due, Coastal Bites shall remit the credit amount to LHRG within thirty (30) days of issuance.

8.4 LHRG shall not be obliged to return Products before receiving a credit note, and Coastal Bites shall not refuse collection of Products that are the subject of a valid return notice under this Article 8.

ARTICLE 9: LATE DELIVERY AND PENALTIES

9.1 Time is of the essence with respect to Coastal Bites’ delivery obligations under this Agreement. Each delivery must be made no later than the delivery time specified in the applicable Purchase Order, provided that the delivery time has been confirmed in accordance with clause 4.3.

9.2 If Coastal Bites delivers any Products after the agreed delivery time (a “Late Delivery”), LHRG shall be entitled to reject the delivery and claim a penalty in accordance with this Article 9, without prejudice to any other right or remedy available to LHRG under this Agreement or at law.

9.3 Coastal Bites Supply Co. is subject to a penalty rate per day late delivery of 0.02. Record status: current. The penalty shall be calculated as follows:

(a) The penalty for a Late Delivery shall be two percent (2%) of the value of the Products in the affected Purchase Order, multiplied by the number of days (or part thereof) of delay, up to a maximum of ten percent (10%) of the value of the affected Purchase Order.

(b) “Value of the Products” means the contract price for the Products in the affected Purchase Order, excluding VAT and any delivery charges.

(c) “Day” means a calendar day, including weekends and public holidays. A delay of less than one full day shall be counted as one day for the purpose of calculating the penalty.

9.4 By way of example only, and not by way of limitation:

(a) If a Purchase Order with a value of ₦500,000 is delivered two (2) days late, the penalty shall be ₦500,000 × 0.02 × 2 = ₦20,000.

(b) If a Purchase Order with a value of ₦1,250,000 is delivered seven (7) days late, the penalty shall be ₦1,250,000 × 0.02 × 7 = ₦175,000, which does not exceed the ten percent (10%) maximum of ₦125,000? For the avoidance of doubt, the maximum penalty for any single Late Delivery shall be ten percent (10%) of the value of the affected Purchase Order. Accordingly, in this example the penalty shall be capped at ₦125,000.

9.5 LHRG may, in its sole discretion, deduct the penalty from any amount due to Coastal Bites under this Agreement, or may invoice Coastal Bites for the penalty, which shall be payable within fourteen (14) days of the invoice date.

9.6 The penalty shall be LHRG’s sole and exclusive remedy for Late Delivery, except where the Late Delivery is caused by Coastal Bites’ fraud, wilful default, or gross negligence, in which case LHRG shall retain all rights and remedies available at law or in equity.

9.7 For the avoidance of doubt, a Late Delivery that is caused by a Force Majeure Event shall be dealt with under Article 7, and no penalty shall apply to the extent the delay is attributable to such Force Majeure Event.

9.8 Coastal Bites shall notify LHRG in writing as soon as it becomes aware that a delivery may be late, stating the reason for the delay and the expected delivery date. Such notification shall not affect LHRG’s right to claim a penalty under this Article 9.

ARTICLE 10: PAYMENT TERMS

10.1 LHRG shall pay the contract price for Products delivered and accepted in accordance with this Agreement, net of any deductions or set-offs permitted under this Agreement, within thirty (30) days of the date of a correct and undisputed invoice.
ARTICLE 11: INSPECTION, ACCEPTANCE, AND REJECTION

11.1 All Products delivered under this Agreement shall be subject to inspection and acceptance by LHRG or its authorised representative at the point of delivery, before the Products are offloaded from the delivery vehicle. LHRG shall have the right to reject any Products that do not conform to the Specifications, are damaged, spoiled, or otherwise unfit for the purpose for which they are intended.

11.2 Inspection shall include, but shall not be limited to, verification of quantity, temperature at the time of delivery (for chilled or frozen Products), packaging integrity, remaining shelf life, and compliance with the food safety and labelling requirements set out in the Specifications. LHRG may also, at its discretion, open and inspect samples of sealed or packaged Products.

11.3 Acceptance of a delivery shall be evidenced by LHRG signing the delivery note or waybill presented by Coastal Bites’ driver. A signature on the delivery note shall not constitute acceptance of Products that are later found to have latent defects not reasonably discoverable at the time of delivery.

11.4 Coastal Bites shall permit LHRG or its representatives to conduct audits of Coastal Bites’ premises, storage facilities, and delivery vehicles during normal business hours and upon reasonable notice, for the purpose of verifying compliance with this Agreement, including health and safety standards and traceability requirements.

11.5 If any Products are rejected pursuant to this Article 11, LHRG shall notify Coastal Bites in writing within two (2) business days of the rejection, stating the reason. Coastal Bites shall, at its own cost, collect the rejected Products within three (3) business days of such notification. If Coastal Bites fails to collect the rejected Products within that period, LHRG may dispose of them or return them at Coastal Bites’ cost.

11.6 Rejected Products shall not be counted as delivered for the purpose of calculating any payment or penalty under this Agreement, and LHRG shall be entitled to a replacement delivery or a credit note, at LHRG’s option.

(c) comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and standards in Nigeria, including the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) requirements and any Lagos State environmental health regulations;

(d) not be adulterated, misbranded, or otherwise in violation of the Consumer Protection Act or any other applicable legislation.

This shall be in addition to any other rights LHRG may have under this Agreement or at law.

B. Coastal Bites is engaged in the business of sourcing, processing, and supplying high-quality food products to hotels, restaurants, and catering establishments across Lagos State.

C. The Parties wish to enter into a formal agreement to govern the terms and conditions under which Coastal Bites shall supply products to LHRG.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:

ARTICLE 1: DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires:
(a) “Affiliate” means, with respect to any person, any other person that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with such person.
(b) “Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in Lagos State, Nigeria.
(c) “Delivery Schedule” means the weekly delivery schedule agreed upon by the Parties as set out in Schedule A hereto, as may be amended from time to time in writing.
(d) “Force Majeure Event” means any event or circumstance beyond the reasonable control of the affected Party, including but not limited to acts of God, fire, flood, storm, earthquake, epidemic, pandemic, riot, civil commotion, strike, lockout, labour dispute, war, terrorism, governmental action, or any other similar event.
(e) “Products” means the food products and supplies listed in Schedule B hereto, as may be updated from time to time.
(f) “Quality Standards” means the standards set out in Article 4 and Schedule C hereto.
(g) “Services” means the delivery, unloading, and related services to be provided by Coastal Bites as described herein.

1.2 Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

1.3 Words importing the singular shall include the plural and vice versa, and words importing any gender shall include all genders.

ARTICLE 2: TERM AND EFFECTIVE DATE

Coastal Bites Supply Co. supply_contract_effective_date 2025-01-15 date. Record status: historical.

2.1 This Agreement shall commence on 15 January 2025 (the “Effective Date”) and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of twenty-four (24) months (the “Initial Term”), unless earlier terminated in accordance with the provisions of Article 12.

2.2 Upon expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods (each a “Renewal Term”) unless either Party provides the other with written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

2.3 The Parties acknowledge and agree that the Effective Date is 15 January 2025, and all obligations, deliveries, and payments shall be calculated and performed with reference to this date. Any deliveries required prior to the Effective Date shall be governed by the terms of any prior purchase orders, and this Agreement shall only govern deliveries made on or after the Effective Date.

ARTICLE 3: SUPPLY OF PRODUCTS

3.1 Coastal Bites shall supply to LHRG, and LHRG shall purchase from Coastal Bites, the Products in such quantities as LHRG may from time to time require, subject to the minimum and maximum order quantities set out in Schedule B.

3.2 All orders for Products shall be placed by LHRG through its designated procurement officer or such other authorized representative as LHRG may notify to Coastal Bites in writing. Orders may be placed by email, telephone, or through the online ordering portal established by Coastal Bites, if any.

3.3 Each order shall specify:
(a) the Products required;
(b) the quantity of each Product;
(c) the requested delivery date and time;
(d) the delivery location; and
(e) any special handling or packaging requirements.

3.4 Coastal Bites shall acknowledge receipt of each order within four (4) hours during normal working hours (8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., WAT, Monday through Friday) and shall confirm its ability to fulfil the order within twenty-four (24) hours of receipt.

ARTICLE 9: LATE DELIVERY AND PENALTIES

9.1 Time is of the essence with respect to Coastal Bites’ delivery obligations under this Agreement. Each delivery must be made no later than the delivery time specified in the applicable Purchase Order, provided that the delivery time has been confirmed in accordance with clause 4.3.

9.2 If Coastal Bites delivers any Products after the agreed delivery time (a “Late Delivery”), LHRG shall be entitled to reject the delivery and claim a penalty in accordance with this Article 9, without prejudice to any other right or remedy available to LHRG under this Agreement or at law.

9.3 Coastal Bites Supply Co. is subject to a penalty rate per day late delivery of 0.02. Record status: current. The penalty shall be calculated as follows:

(a) The penalty for a Late Delivery shall be two percent (2%) of the value of the Products in the affected Purchase Order, multiplied by the number of days (or part thereof) of delay, up to a maximum of ten percent (10%) of the value of the affected Purchase Order.

(b) “Value of the Products” means the contract price for the Products in the affected Purchase Order, excluding VAT and any delivery charges.

(c) “Day” means a calendar day, including weekends and public holidays. A delay of less than one full day shall be counted as one day for the purpose of calculating the penalty.

9.4 By way of example only, and not by way of limitation:

(a) If a Purchase Order with a value of ₦500,000 is delivered two (2) days late, the penalty shall be ₦500,000 × 0.02 × 2 = ₦20,000.

(b) If a Purchase Order with a value of ₦1,250,000 is delivered seven (7) days late, the penalty shall be ₦1,250,000 × 0.02 × 7 = ₦175,000, which does not exceed the ten percent (10%) maximum of ₦125,000? For the avoidance of doubt, the maximum penalty for any single Late Delivery shall be ten percent (10%) of the value of the affected Purchase Order. Accordingly, in this example the penalty shall be capped at ₦125,000.

9.5 LHRG may, in its sole discretion, deduct the penalty from any amount due to Coastal Bites under this Agreement, or may invoice Coastal Bites for the penalty, which shall be payable within fourteen (14) days of the invoice date.

9.6 The penalty shall be LHRG’s sole and exclusive remedy for Late Delivery, except where the Late Delivery is caused by Coastal Bites’ fraud, wilful default, or gross negligence, in which case LHRG shall retain all rights and remedies available at law or in equity.

9.7 For the avoidance of doubt, a Late Delivery that is caused by a Force Majeure Event shall be dealt with under Article 7, and no penalty shall apply to the extent the delay is attributable to such Force Majeure Event.

9.8 Coastal Bites shall notify LHRG in writing as soon as it becomes aware that a delivery may be late, stating the reason for the delay and the expected delivery date. Such notification shall not affect LHRG’s right to claim a penalty under this Article 9.
